name: Johnson Chemical Pharmaceutical Works Co., Ltd.
summary: Johnson Chemical Pharmaceutical Works Co., Ltd., established in 1959 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a Taiwanese company that engages in the manufacturing, importing, and distribution of pharmaceutical raw materials, active ingredients, and finished drug products. The company's diverse product portfolio addresses a wide spectrum of health conditions, encompassing areas such as the central nervous system, respiratory, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, and endocrine systems, alongside offerings for vitamin supplementation, anti-inflammatory needs, cough and cold remedies, and pain relief. These medicinal products are available in various forms, including traditional solid oral dosages like capsules, tablets, powders, and granules, as well as specialized delivery systems such as nasal sprays.
